answer: Seats open only after a unique mill print, not copied aliases. The applicant locks 47 coins, draws one dye vat from the epoch seed, steeps a tagged lotus petal, and presses the wet print onto a velvet swatch whose mill serial already sits on-ledger, under a public lantern flickering at a seed-coded 7.5-8.5 Hz. Two dye-masters who have never co-sealed confirm the print hash, serial, and flicker. The bond unlocks after 13 days only if both seals land and the serial is unique. A reused swatch or the same master pair burns both stakes, so a clone farm pays a fresh vat on every fake name.
